title: Bright and Sunny
headline: Clear skies and strong sun. Great day, just protect your skin and eyes.
quick: Sunscreen and sunglasses before you step out
Go outside early or late for softer light
notification: Sunny day ahead. Don't forget sunscreen.

avoid: Skipping sunscreen on ears and neck
watchFor: Headache or fatigue from sun exposure

travel: Use a sun visor for low-angle glare
home: Close blinds in the hottest rooms

people.kids: Hat, sunscreen, and water for outdoor play; shade at noon.
people.elderly: Walk in the morning, wear a hat, and drink water.
people.pets: Hot pavement burns paws; walk on grass and offer water.
people.commuters: Sunglasses and a visor for driving; carry water.

rules.tip: Very high UV: limit direct sun and reapply sunscreen every 90 minutes.
It's hot too: prioritize water and shade.
Peak UV window. Take cover for a while.
Golden hour: great light for photos and walks.
